name: com.mjgame.nmd.nkl.20
description:
Core framework dung chung cho game mobile Unity. Core 2.0 duoc xay dung lai voi kien truc, coding structure va workflow moi, thay the Core 1.x. Bao gom UI, Save, Pool, StateMachine, Audio, Camera, Joystick, Indicator, Trigger, Extensions va Editor Tools.

DOTween can duoc import rieng. Sau khi import, mo Tools > Demigiant > DOTween Utility Panel va Create ASMDEF de tao DOTween.Modules.asmdef.

release.notes: New generation of MJGame Core. Completely rebuilt from the ground up and replaces the legacy Core 1.x architecture.
